patterns: do we have to wear uniform
responses:
**Uniform schedule at NU Laguna:**
- **Monday, Tuesday, Thursday:** the regular uniform for your program, with black shoes
- **Friday:** E-Sports uniform with proper rubber shoes
- **Wednesday and Saturday:** wash days, civilian clothes allowed (the student dress code still applies)

Tourism, Psychology, and Exercise and Sports Science students may wear their program uniforms. You can buy uniforms at **NU Bulldogs Exchange** on campus.

patterns: Is hazing allowed in NU Laguna
responses:
NU Laguna enforces a strict anti-hazing policy in line with **RA 8049 (Anti-Hazing Law)**. To report hazing or bullying:
- Go to the **Discipline Office** or **Guidance Office** on the ground floor
- Or email gso@nu-laguna.edu.ph

We maintain a **zero-tolerance** policy on hazing. You can report it to:
- The Discipline Office or Guidance Office (ground floor)
- gso@nu-laguna.edu.ph
